d: Everyone at the supermarket enjoys a brief moment of respite, until a cat sneaks in and wreaks havoc inside the store.
A few months after the Nyandemic outbreak, Kunagi and Kaoru saves a boy called Arata on their way to meet Tsutsumi.
In the battle against Diamond Kingdom, Yami helps Vangeance, captain of Golden Dawn to dodge the attack from Lotus.
After the battle in Kiten, Yami introduces Asta to Owen, a healing mage who is under the Wizard King, to treat his arms.
